_about: PARKED DRAFT (docs/narrative/pending/). Between-stage beats for a run across one planet (docs/narrative/story-beats.md). Each beat names the run state it needs; a beat is two to four short lines. The state fields are Narrative's proposal; Game Design's run-mode.md (docs/design) decides the real ones. Every line passes the lint (4 to 12 words, banned words, ellipsis cap). Speakers: hero (the player's fighter, voiced as the Protagonist for now), rival, boss, crowd, radio (an in-world broadcast, never a narrator). Unsearched by Legal; for Orb's marks.

state.stage: early (stages 1 to 2) | mid | late (the stage before the boss approach)
state.cities: none | some | many (cities fallen this run)
state.city_cause: hero | rival | boss | both (who did the most damage to cities)
state.casualties: none | some | many (this stage's gap, or the run so far: Game Design decides the window)
state.branch: none | witnessed | tested (the hero's branch; anguish-branches.md)
state.result: won | won_close | lost_close | lost (the stage just finished)
state.boss_in: 3 | 2 | 1 | 0 (stages until the boss; 0 is the final approach)
state.avoided_towns: true when the hero kept the fight away from settlements
state.rival_here: true when the rival appears in this gap

lines.text: Nothing broken. Good. Let's keep it that way.
The city's untouched. Stay clear of the fighting.

beats.note: A clean first stage.

lines.text: Three fights and no city's hurt. Keep going.
Don't get smug. I'm still here.

beats.note: A clean run so far; the rival is in the gap.

lines.text: I broke that street. I know it.
Look at the windows. All of them.
Next time I'm taking it somewhere empty.

beats.note: One city damaged by the hero's own blows: shame, not power.

lines.text: You didn't have to hit the street!
It was in the way.
People live on that street!

beats.note: A city damaged by the rival, who is present.

lines.text: Two cities down. Both because of me.
We trusted you to keep it away.

beats.note: The cost of fighting in cities, owned by the hero.

lines.text: He flattened three cities and kept walking.
Three cities lost. The fighting follows him.

beats.note: The rival's trail of damage.

lines.text: Look at that. We did that together.
Don't say 'we'. I didn't want this.

beats.note: Both fighters share the damage; the rival needles.

lines.text: You took it out to the hills. Thank you.
Just doing my job. Is everyone okay?

beats.note: The hero lured the fight away from people.

lines.text: Is everybody out? Count them again.
We're all safe. Thanks to you.

beats.note: No one died; a check anyway.

lines.text: People got hurt. Because of me.
My brother was in that building.
I'm sorry. I should've been faster.

beats.note: Casualties the hero caused: grief and apology, no power-up.

lines.text: You were supposed to protect us!
I know. I'm sorry.

beats.note: Many casualties, hero's fault: the crowd turns on him.

lines.text: They were just standing there. Why?
They shouldn't have stayed.

beats.note: The rival's casualties: the setup for the witnessed branch.

lines.text: That's too many. I'm done being polite.
Finally. Now you look like you mean it.

beats.note: Many casualties by the rival: the Protagonist stops playing.

lines.text: Two districts didn't make it out.
Whoever's behind this did it on purpose.

beats.note: Casualties the boss caused.

lines.text: I'm not playing anymore.
Good. That's the look I wanted.
Stay behind me. All of you.

beats.note: Branch A begins (anguish-branches.md).

lines.text: No jokes. Not tonight.
You finally look dangerous.

beats.note: Branch A continues across a stage.

lines.text: Is anyone hurt? Anyone at all?
We're okay. We're all okay.
Good. I can breathe again.

beats.note: Branch A fades when no one else is hurt.

lines.text: That form of yours was incredible. Seriously.
Don't compliment me. Fight me.
I am! This is what I wanted!

beats.note: Branch B begins: the hero let the rival power up first.

lines.text: Higher every fight. I love it.
You're enjoying this too much.

beats.note: Branch B continues.

lines.text: Let the boss go first. I want to see it.
You're insane. That's why you're annoying.

beats.note: Branch B looks ahead to the boss.

lines.text: That's it? I'm barely warm.
Then let's get you warm!

beats.note: The rival is bored; the hero is eager.

lines.text: You're improving. Don't let it go to your head.
Thanks! Hey, you're good too!

beats.note: A tepid compliment from the rival.

lines.text: You asked for my best. Here it comes.
Everybody back! He's serious this time!

beats.note: The rival at full menace.

lines.text: That man in the glasses scares me.
He's rough, but he's not here for you.

beats.note: A civilian's view of the rival.

lines.text: Don't lose to the boss. That's my job.
Is that your way of saying good luck?

beats.note: The rival's pride claims the boss.

lines.text: That was close! My arms are shaking!
Lucky. That's all that was.

beats.note: A narrow win.

lines.text: One more hit. I was that close.
Close doesn't count. Try again.
Get up! You almost had him!

beats.note: A narrow loss: the retry beat.

lines.text: He's faster than me. I need to see why.
You're not even trying to win.

beats.note: A clear loss; the hero is curious, not crushed.

lines.text: I was down to my last breath.
And you got up. Annoying.
He almost fell! And then he didn't!

beats.note: A win after being nearly beaten.

lines.text: Round two. Same fight, smarter me.
Again? You never learn.

beats.note: A win after losing the stage before.

lines.text: Three wins since that loss. Feels good.
Don't count them. I'm still counting.

beats.note: A run of wins since a loss.

lines.text: Something's coming. The sky's gone dark up north.
Whatever it is, we'll be ready.

beats.note: Three stages out: the first sign.

lines.text: Three more districts evacuated. The ground's shaking.
Do you feel that? The whole street's humming.

beats.note: Two stages out.

lines.text: It's close. I can feel it in my teeth.
Stay with me. Last one before it.

beats.note: One stage out.

lines.text: The sky's gone black. Ash everywhere.
It's the middle of the day!
Everyone inside! Now! Move!

beats.note: Set piece 1 of 8: the sky changes.

lines.text: Final evacuation order. Leave the cities now.
Take the children! Go!
Go! I'll hold it off.

beats.note: Set piece 2 of 8: the last evacuation.

lines.text: Don't misunderstand. I just want the first hit.
I wasn't going to say anything.

beats.note: Set piece 3 of 8: the rival joins, on his own terms.

lines.text: There you are. I was getting bored.
You're the one behind all this?

beats.note: Set piece 4 of 8: the boss arrives (generic).

lines.text: Petitioners! You're late. We've started without you.
Spare me the speech.

beats.note: Set piece 4 of 8: the Empress arrives.

lines.text: Welcome, gentlemen! Your table's been waiting.
I'm not eating here.

beats.note: Set piece 4 of 8: the Cyborg arrives.

lines.text: You hurt them. That ends now.
They were scenery. You're next.

beats.note: Set piece 5 of 8: the hero in branch A.

lines.text: Show me everything. I'll wait.
Careful. I don't do half measures.

beats.note: Set piece 5 of 8: the hero in branch B.

lines.text: Let's finish this. Everybody back!
Everyone back? How sweet of you.

beats.note: Set piece 5 of 8: the hero, no branch.

lines.text: Stay out of my way. This one's mine.
Not a chance. We do this together.

beats.note: Set piece 6 of 8: the two argue over the boss.

lines.text: Look at the sky. That's what I do.
Stop it! There are people down there!

beats.note: Set piece 7 of 8: the boss's threat (generic).

lines.text: Watch the sky, petitioners. It's our province now.
Stop it! There are people down there!

beats.note: Set piece 7 of 8: the Empress's threat.

lines.text: Dinner is served, gentlemen. The whole planet.
Stop it! There are people down there!

beats.note: Set piece 7 of 8: the Cyborg's threat.

lines.text: Here we go! Give me everything!
Don't die before I hit it.
Come on, then. Entertain us.

beats.note: Set piece 8 of 8: the first blow.
